animations.name: sonner-fade-in
animations.css: @keyframes sonner-fade-in { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(.8) } 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1) } }
animations.description: Fade in animation for toast notifications

animations.name: sonner-fade-out
animations.css: @keyframes sonner-fade-out { 0% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1) } 100% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(.8) } }
animations.description: Fade out animation for toast notifications

animations.name: fadeIn
animations.description: Generic fade in animation for drawer overlays

animations.name: fadeOut
animations.description: Generic fade out animation for drawer overlays

animations.name: slideFromBottom
animations.css: @keyframes slideFromBottom { from { transform: translate3d(0, var(--initial-transform, 100%), 0) } to { transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0) } }
animations.description: Slide up animation for bottom drawers

animations.name: slideToBottom
animations.description: Slide down dismiss animation for bottom drawers

animations.name: slideFromTop
animations.css: @keyframes slideFromTop { from { transform: translate3d(0, calc(var(--initial-transform, 100%) * -1), 0) } to { transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0) } }
animations.description: Slide down animation for top drawers

animations.name: slideToTop
animations.description: Slide up dismiss animation for top drawers

animations.name: swipe-out-left
animations.css: @keyframes swipe-out-left { from { transform: var(--y) translateX(var(--swipe-amount-x)); opacity: 1 } to { transform: var(--y) translateX(calc(var(--swipe-amount-x) - 100%)); opacity: 0 } }
animations.description: Swipe dismiss animation for toast notifications swiped left

animations.name: swipe-out-right
animations.css: @keyframes swipe-out-right { from { transform: var(--y) translateX(var(--swipe-amount-x)); opacity: 1 } to { transform: var(--y) translateX(calc(var(--swipe-amount-x) + 100%)); opacity: 0 } }
animations.description: Swipe dismiss animation for toast notifications swiped right

animations.description: Wishlist button scale animation on hover/active states

insights: The design system uses a monochromatic palette with rounded-full pill buttons as the primary action pattern, creating a soft, approachable feel that contrasts with the rich property photography.

Hover states rely heavily on subtle background color shifts (from transparent to light gray) rather than dramatic visual changes, maintaining the minimal aesthetic while providing clear interactive feedback.
The drawer/modal system uses sophisticated spring-based animations (cubic-bezier 0.32, 0.72, 0, 1) that feel natural and responsive, with consistent 500ms durations for larger surface transitions.
